summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Elbit Systems Ltd. attaching the proxy statement and proxy card for its annual general meeting of shareholders scheduled for August 5, 2026. The filing contains standard meeting agenda items such as director elections and auditor appointments with no mention of any special situation transaction, strategic review, activist campaign, or corporate action. As a routine proxy circular for an annual meeting, this does not qualify as a special situation event.
